content: Hekɨaripa miemete wahepaɨ xekeneyɨaka
'Ayumieme Kakaɨyari xe'ɨketɨ xekenakɨni. Kemɨ'ane mɨxenaki'erie niwemama wahepaɨ xekeneyɨaka.
Xeteyukanaki'erietɨ xekeneu'uwani, yaxeikɨa Kɨritsitu kemɨtatinaki'erie, kemɨtiyuyetua tahetsiemieme mɨmierienikɨ. Mawaritɨtɨ kaniyuyetuani 'ixatɨatɨ Kakaɨyari, 'inaki'atsitɨatɨ.

Hipatɨ mekaniwakumaɨwani kemɨ'ane mɨkawa'ɨya mɨkawakɨna, mepɨka'itiyatɨka, yuhetsiemieme mekatenihiwe'erieka naime. Matsi kememɨteyurie, mɨkɨ xepɨkakuxatani xeme, meuyewetsekɨ mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme memupatsie mɨpaɨ memɨkateyuriekakɨ.

Hipatɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniyurieka, ketemɨtetewinɨarienikekai xɨka wahepaɨ teteyuriekake. Yakɨ xeikɨa mekaniutiyuaneni, mekaniyunanaimaka 'axamɨ'anekɨ. 'Aixɨa pɨka'ane mɨpaɨ xemɨteyuriekakɨ, matsi peuyewetse Kakaɨyari pamɨpariyutsi xemipitɨakakɨ.

Teɨteri mepɨwakumaɨwa kemɨ'ane mɨkawa'ɨya mɨkawakɨna, mepɨka'itiyatɨka, naime mepɨtehiwe'erie yuhetsiemieme. Tita mɨtihiwe'erie, mɨkɨ payexeiya yukakaɨyaritɨme. 'Ipaɨ xeketenemaika, yunaitɨ mɨya memɨteyurie, mɨkɨ wahetsie pɨkatinake memaye'axɨanikɨ Kɨritsitu tiwa'aitɨwame mayanikɨ, meta Kakaɨyari.
Nɨkatɨ xewitɨ tixe'u'itaiya 'eka niuki wewietɨ. Mɨya memɨteyuriekɨ, 'ayumieme Kakaɨyari pɨwaheka mɨkɨ memɨkayuwaɨriya yamemɨtekahunikɨ.
Merikɨte, xepɨkayuxewiriyani wahamatɨa kememɨteyurie.
Meripaitɨ yɨwipa xepɨmiemetetɨkai, hikɨri matsi hekɨaripa miemete xekanakɨne Ti'aitame hetsie xetewiyatɨ. Hekɨaripa miemete wahepaɨ xekeneyɨaka.
(Hekɨariya kemɨtixuaweriya, 'ipaɨ katiniyurienemɨkɨ tewi. Naimekɨ 'aixɨa katiniyurienemɨkɨ, heitseriemekɨ yakatinikamiemɨkɨ, yuri kaniutainemɨkɨ).
Xekeneyɨ'ɨwiya yaxemɨtehetimanikɨ tita Ti'aitame mɨtinake.
Xepɨkayuxewiriyani mɨkɨ yɨwipa timieme kememɨteyurie wahamatɨa. Tixaɨtɨ pɨkatitixuawere kememɨteyurie. Matsi xekeniwahekɨatani kememɨteyurie.
'Awie kememɨteyurie mɨkɨ, putewiuyɨkɨre mɨwakuxatanikɨ.
Peru mɨkɨ naitɨ hekɨatsietɨ, matsiɨkɨtɨ kanayeitɨariwani hekɨaripa. Hekɨariya kanihɨkɨtɨni tita matsiɨkɨme mɨrayeitɨa naime.
'Ayumieme mɨpaɨ paine:
'Ayumieme xekeneyukweriwayurieka 'aixɨa kexemɨte'u'uwa. 'Atsimemɨkatemate wahepaɨ xepɨkayɨaka, memɨtemaiwawe wahepaɨ pɨta xekeneyɨaka,
xekeneyukumexuitɨaka 'aixɨa xemɨteyurienikɨ, mexi tukari xepitɨarie hipatɨ tukari 'axamɨ'anenekɨ.
'Ayumieme 'atsimemɨkatemate wahepaɨ xepɨkayɨaka, matsi pɨta xekenemaika tita Ti'aitame mɨtinake.
Xepɨkatarɨwetɨweni winukɨ. Mɨpaɨ tiyurienetɨ pɨrukuyaneni xeikɨa. Matsi 'Iyarikɨ pɨta xekenehɨpɨneni.
Yuxexuitɨ xekeneyutuikani, nɨawari hepaɨtsita meta Kakaɨyari kwikarieyakɨ, kwikari 'Iyaritsie timieme hepaɨtsita manuyɨne xekeneutikwika, xe'inɨawatɨ Ti'aitame yu'iyaritsie.
Yuheyemekɨ naimekɨ pamɨpariyutsi xekenepitɨaka Kakaɨyari mɨta'ukiyari, Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu hetsɨa xemɨmiemetekɨ.
Xeyuxewitɨ yaxeketenekahuni
Xeyuxewitɨ yaxeketenekahuni Kɨritsitu xe'ayemakatɨ.
'Ukari yaxeketenekahuni xekɨnama kememaitɨka, yaxeikɨa kexemɨtekahu Ti'aitame ti'aitakaku.
'Uki 'uka mu'uya kanihɨkɨtɨni, yaxeikɨata Kɨritsitu memɨyutixexeɨriwa wamu'u kanihɨkɨtɨni, mɨkɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni kemɨ'ane yuwaiyari mutawikweitsitɨa.
Memɨyutixexeɨriwa yamekatenikahuni kemɨti'aita Kɨritsitu, yaxeikɨata 'ukari yameketekahuni kememaitɨka wakɨnama naimekɨ.
Xeme 'ukitsi xekeniwanaki'erieka yɨ'ɨitama, Kɨritsitu mɨtiwanaki'erie hepaɨ memɨyutixexeɨriwa, mɨyuyetua hepaɨ mɨmierienikɨ wahetsiemieme.
Yuhetsiemieme mɨwapatakɨ mɨpaɨ katiniuyurieni, wa'itietɨ hakɨ niukikɨ.

Mɨpaɨ pɨtiuyuri yɨkɨmana, yɨhɨxie mɨwati'uitɨanikɨ memɨyutixexeɨriwa witsime'aneneme, mekaheukuyɨyɨwime, mekaheuwiwirawime, tsepa tixaɨtɨ mɨpaɨ mɨti'ane, matsi memɨpatsiekakɨ pɨta wahetsie mɨkarahɨiwanikɨ.
Yaxeikɨa kaneuyeweka 'ukitsi memɨwanaki'eriekakɨ yɨ'ɨitama, yuwaiyari memɨtenaki'erie hepaɨ. Kemɨ'ane yɨ'ɨya minaki'erie, mɨkɨ kaniyunaki'erieka.
Tewi hatsuaku yuwaiyari pɨka'uxie, matsi piweriya pikemaritɨa. Kɨritsitu yaxeikɨa pɨwayurie memɨyutixexeɨriwa,
waiyarieya temɨhɨkɨkɨ. Waiyarieya 'umeyarieya tepɨhɨkɨ tame.
Kemaine: «'Ayumieme 'uki kaniyupatamɨkɨ, yupaapa yumaama wahetsɨa kanayeyeimɨkɨ, yɨ'ɨyatsie pɨta katiniwiyamɨkɨ, memɨyuhutakai xeiwaiyari mekanakɨnikuni meyuxewitɨ».
'Ikɨ niuki matsi kanitɨrɨkaɨyeni, tsepa mɨ'awietsiekai, Kɨritsitu hetsiemieme memɨyutixexeɨriwa wahepaɨtsita nepaine.
Merikɨte xemeta yuxexuitɨ yunaitɨ yɨ'ɨitama xekeniwanaki'erieka kexemɨteyunaki'erie hepaɨ, meta 'ukari yɨkɨnama 'aixɨa meketewaxeiyani.
